listing.name: Quake (vkQuake)
listing.summary: Windows prepared-player route: use a complete permitted vkQuake1.37.0 copy with your own compatible Quake data. Upstream owns preparation, store/data selection, actual profile roots and replacement; Core offers explicit nonowning registration and selected-process Play. Original, mod, save and other-platform qualification remain separate.

steps.title: Keep the complete upstream player
steps.instruction: Use an already permitted Windows x64 vkQuake1.37.0 installation or complete official Windows x64 ZIP, including its libraries/resources. Select the native vkQuake.exe player, not the installer, launcher shortcut or dedicated-server invocation. The normal source entry owns the Host_Frame loop in that process. Vulkan-capable hardware is required; this guide does not qualify your GPU or game.

steps.title: Finish your own Quake data setup upstream
steps.instruction: Prepare your own supported classic or rerelease Quake data using the upstream installer/store discovery or complete portable-copy instructions. Keep actual base/id1 PAKs and selected expansions/mods with their compatible data. Finish the upstream picker and normal start/quit before registration. Do not overwrite your only retained copy while changing engines. Engine licensing does not license original assets or arbitrary mods; Core does not acquire, hash-admit or import these originals.

steps.title: Retain the established launch coordinates
steps.instruction: Use the actual prepared runtime directory as working directory and the same supported literal arguments as your working setup. Preserve an actually used -basedir plus its absolute path as separate tokens, existing game/edition and -multiuser choices; do not introduce another profile or choose a different store edition merely to register it. Review exact intent/consent, then choose Play separately.

steps.title: Preserve both portable and discovered profile roots
steps.instruction: Standalone copies can write beneath the prepared base/game directories, but store selection or -multiuser uses the actual SDL vkQuake preference directory (normally APPDATA/vkQuake on Windows). Preserve that actual root and basedirs.txt, global vkQuake.cfg, game-local configs, saves/autosaves/screenshots/demos, all base/id1/mod files, the complete runtime and unknowns. Keep relevant existing Steam/GOG/Epic/Nightdive and Steam-userdata/custom roots too; another runtime folder is not proof of independent state.

steps.title: Keep replacement and removal ownership clear
steps.instruction: Close all real instances before external file changes. Upstream/player owns preparation, runtime replacement, profile writes and any migration/recovery. Preserve the old creating copy and every actual data root, finish deliberate replacement upstream and review/relink the changed player before the next Play. Core observes only its separately consented selected process, not an exclusive instance family or sandbox, and does not adopt unrelated helpers/successors. Registration-only removal preserves all external files. No Core-managed acquisition/setup/update/backup/rollback/migration/deletion is offered by this route.

warnings: This guide adds no Supported promotion, original/component permission, acquired-source-to-binary or private-output certificate. Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use.
Source/API and inert native probes are distinct from actual game/save/mod/network, installed Desktop, physical/human, other-platform or protected acceptance. No such new observation is claimed.
Keep complete actual external runtime and player-data roots recoverable before upstream changes; another player folder does not guarantee independent shared state.
